Plot a query tRNA on a reference cloverleaf, highlighting differences

Source: R/plot-structure.R
plot_tRNA_diff.Rd

Draws the bundled cloverleaf for a reference tRNA and overlays how a query tRNA differs from it, so that several queries share one layout. Positions are matched through Sprinzl labels (see diff_sprinzl()):

Usage

plot_tRNA_diff(
  trna,
  organism,
  reference_coords,
  reference_id,
  query_coords,
  query_id,
  output = NULL,
  position_markers = TRUE
)

Arguments

trna, organism

The bundled reference structure, as in plot_tRNA_structure().

reference_coords, query_coords

Tibbles of Sprinzl coordinates as returned by read_sprinzl_coords(). The reference positions must correspond to the nucleotides of the bundled structure.

reference_id, query_id

The trna_id of the reference and query tRNA within their coordinate tables.

output

Path for the output SVG file. If NULL (default), writes to a temporary file.

position_markers

Logical; if TRUE (default), draw small grey numbers at Sprinzl positions 10, 20, 30, ... Unlike plot_tRNA_structure(), these are Sprinzl labels, not sequence indices.

Value

The path to the annotated SVG file (invisibly).

Details

  • A reference position missing from the query is drawn as an empty grey circle with no letter.

  • A position with a different base shows the query base, outlined.

  • A query base with no reference position cannot sit in the reference layout, so it is marked by a small dot on the backbone and listed in the legend. Inserted bases at the 5' end are placed at the first nucleotide and those at the 3' end at the last.

Nothing in the reference layout moves; bases that match are drawn as in plot_tRNA_structure().

Examples

# \donttest{
ecoli <- read_sprinzl_coords(
  clover_example("sprinzl/ecoliK12_global_coords.tsv.gz")
)
t4 <- read_sprinzl_coords(
  clover_example("sprinzl/phageT4_global_coords.tsv.gz")
)
plot_tRNA_diff(
  "tRNA-Gly-TCC",
  "Escherichia coli",
  reference_coords = ecoli,
  reference_id = "tRNA-Gly-UCC-1-1",
  query_coords = t4,
  query_id = "tRNA-Gly-UCC"
)
# }
